code_set.hcc_model: PY2026 midyear final model software CMS-HCC software V2826.115.T1.zip (C2824T2N.csv, V28115H1.TXT)

topics.title: Chronic kidney disease
topics.description: CKD stages, hypertensive CKD and dialysis status.

topics.title: Diabetes
topics.description: Diabetes type, complications, the "with" convention and long-term drug use.

topics.title: Diabetes, hypertension and CKD
topics.description: All three together: the 'with' link, hypertensive CKD and the stage code.

topics.title: Dementia
topics.description: Dementia type, stage and behavioral disturbance; mild cognitive impairment.

topics.title: Depression
topics.description: Major depression: single or recurrent, severity, psychotic features and remission.

topics.title: Schizophrenia, bipolar and eating disorders
topics.description: Schizophrenia vs schizoaffective, bipolar episode and remission, personality and eating disorders.

topics.title: Cancer
topics.description: Current cancer versus personal history, and metastases.

topics.title: Rare metabolic and endocrine disorders
topics.description: Lysosomal storage disorders, amyloidosis types, Addison's vs unspecified adrenal insufficiency, Cushing's and acromegaly.

topics.title: Stroke after discharge
topics.description: History of stroke versus residual deficits; dominant and non-dominant side.

topics.title: Paralysis and spinal cord
topics.description: Quadriplegia and paraplegia level and completeness, monoplegia and dominance, cauda equina, myelopathy.

topics.title: Nerve and muscle disorders
topics.description: Motor neuron disease, myasthenia with or without exacerbation, CIDP vs polyneuropathy, muscular dystrophy, cerebral palsy type, hereditary ataxia, Huntington's and anoxic brain damage.

topics.title: Heart failure
topics.description: Heart failure type and acuity, and hypertensive heart disease.

topics.title: Heart attack and angina
topics.description: Recent vs old myocardial infarction (the 4-week rule), and coronary disease with unstable vs unspecified angina.

topics.title: Atrial fibrillation
topics.description: Atrial fibrillation type, current versus history after ablation, and anticoagulant use.

topics.title: Obesity and BMI
topics.description: Obesity versus morbid obesity, and when BMI codes are reportable.

topics.title: Asthma, fibrosis, cystic fibrosis and pneumonia
topics.description: Asthma severity and exacerbation, cystic fibrosis, idiopathic vs unspecified pulmonary fibrosis, tracheostomy and ventilator status, and pneumonia types in the hospital.

topics.title: Peripheral artery disease
topics.description: Atherosclerosis of the legs: claudication, rest pain, ulceration and the ulcer code.

topics.title: DVT and pulmonary embolism
topics.description: Acute vs chronic vs history of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.

topics.title: COPD and respiratory failure
topics.description: COPD, exacerbation or emphysema; chronic respiratory failure versus home oxygen alone.

topics.title: Pressure ulcers
topics.description: Pressure ulcer site and stage, unstageable versus unspecified, and healed ulcers.

topics.title: Bone, lupus, ulcers and burns
topics.description: Osteomyelitis, lupus vs discoid lupus, non-pressure ulcer depth, burn extent (T31) and pemphigus/pemphigoid.

topics.title: Liver disease
topics.description: Cirrhosis types and ascites, chronic versus cured hepatitis C, and fatty liver.

topics.title: Status codes
topics.description: Amputation and ostomy status: level, side, and reversed ostomies.

topics.title: Epilepsy, Parkinson's and MS
topics.description: Epilepsy and intractability, seizure disorder versus a past seizure, Parkinson's disease, MS type.

topics.title: Transplant status
topics.description: Organ and stem cell transplant status (which organs carry an HCC), combined transplants, and rejection.

topics.title: Rheumatoid arthritis
topics.description: Rheumatoid arthritis versus osteoarthritis, rheumatoid factor, and methotrexate use.

topics.title: Sepsis and opportunistic infections
topics.description: Sepsis vs severe sepsis vs septic shock, urosepsis and bacteremia, and opportunistic infections.

topics.title: HIV
topics.description: Asymptomatic HIV, HIV disease, a prior HIV-related illness, and inconclusive tests.

topics.title: IBD and pancreatitis
topics.description: Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis versus IBS; chronic pancreatitis versus a past acute attack.

topics.title: Blood and immune disorders
topics.description: Sickle cell disease versus trait, ITP versus thrombocytopenia, common variable immunodeficiency.

topics.title: Eye: AMD and retinopathy
topics.description: Wet versus dry macular degeneration, proliferative versus nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy.

topics.title: Hip fracture encounters
topics.description: 7th characters: new fracture (A) versus follow-up while healing (D) versus a healed fracture (history).

topics.title: Alcohol use
topics.description: Alcohol use disorder severity and remission versus social drinking.

topics.title: Head injury, vertebral fracture and amputation
topics.description: Brain injury by loss of consciousness vs concussion, vertebral fracture encounter and osteoporosis, traumatic amputation vs amputation status.

topics.title: MEAT documentation
topics.description: Which chronic conditions the note supports: assessed and treated, or only listed.

topics.title: Acceptable sources
topics.description: Which documents can support a risk-adjustment code: a signed provider visit, not a radiology report, a nurse visit or an unsigned note.

ckd_staging.title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
ckd_staging.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.

wrong_ckd_stage.description: Picked a different CKD stage than documented.

under_staged.description: Picked a lower or less specific stage than documented.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported a subcategory that needs more characters.

both_stage_and_esrd.description: Reported a CKD stage together with ESRD.

missed_htn_ckd_link.description: Coded hypertension and CKD separately instead of hypertensive CKD.

wrong_htn_ckd_code.description: Used the hypertensive CKD code for the wrong stage range.

diabetes_acute.title: Diabetes emergencies in the hospital: DKA, HHS and hypoglycemia
diabetes_acute.question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's diabetes (only that code).

values.t2_dka: Type 2 diabetes with ketoacidosis, no coma
values.t1_dka: Type 1 diabetes with ketoacidosis, no coma
values.t2_hhs: Type 2 diabetes with hyperosmolar state, no coma
values.t2_hypo_coma: Type 2 diabetes with hypoglycemia and coma

dka_coded_hyperglycemia.description: Coded diabetes with hyperglycemia for ketoacidosis or a hyperosmolar state (HCC 38 instead of 36).

hyperglycemia_coded_dka.description: Coded ketoacidosis or a hyperosmolar state when only hyperglycemia is documented.

wrong_dm_type.description: Coded the wrong type of diabetes.

missed_coma.description: Coded hypoglycemia without coma when a coma is documented (HCC 38 instead of 36).

diabetes_complications.title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
diabetes_complications.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.

values.no: No statement that it is unrelated
values.yes: Provider says it is NOT caused by the diabetes

missed_with_link.description: Did not apply the 'with' convention, which presumes the link between diabetes and listed conditions.

linked_despite_provider.description: Linked a condition to diabetes after the provider documented it is unrelated.

missed_code_also.description: Left out the additional code the Tabular instructs (e.g., CKD stage).

redundant_manifestation.description: Added a separate code for a manifestation already captured by the combination code.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported a category/subcategory that needs more characters.

missed_complication.description: Coded diabetes without complications when a complication was documented.

coded_unsupported_complication.description: Coded a diabetic complication that was not documented.

missed_med_status.description: Left out the long-term drug use Z code.

only_one_med_code.description: Assigned only one Z code when both insulin and oral hypoglycemics are used.

z794_for_type1.description: Assigned Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes, where insulin use is inherent.

coded_med_not_documented.description: Assigned a long-term drug use code that is not documented.

diabetes_htn_ckd.title: Diabetes, hypertension and CKD together
diabetes_htn_ckd.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.

missed_with_link.description: Coded diabetes without complications although the 'with' convention links diabetes and CKD.

missed_htn_ckd_link.description: Coded hypertension separately instead of hypertensive CKD.

wrong_htn_ckd_code.description: Used the hypertensive CKD code for the wrong stage range.

missed_code_also.description: Left out the CKD stage code that the combination codes ask for.

under_staged.description: Coded a lower CKD stage than documented.

dementia_severity.title: Dementia: type, stage and behavior
dementia_severity.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cognitive disorder.

missed_underlying.description: Left out the underlying condition (G30.9) that is coded first with dementia in other diseases (F02.-).

wrong_dementia_category.description: Used unspecified dementia (F03.-) when the dementia is due to Alzheimer's disease (F02.-).

assumed_severity.description: Coded a dementia stage the provider did not document.

missed_severity.description: Used an unspecified-severity code when the provider documented the stage.

wrong_severity.description: Coded a different stage than documented.

missed_behavior.description: Left out documented agitation (dementia with behavioral disturbance).

unsupported_behavior.description: Coded a behavioral disturbance that is not documented.

coded_dementia_for_mci.description: Coded dementia when the provider documented mild cognitive impairment.

depression_severity.title: Major depression: episode, severity and remission
depression_severity.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's depressive disorder.

severity_up.description: Coded a higher severity than documented.

severity_down.description: Coded a lower severity than documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used the unspecified code when the severity is documented.

assumed_severity.description: Coded a severity the provider did not document.

unsupported_psychotic.description: Coded psychotic features that are not documented.

remission_coded_active.description: Coded an active severity when the provider documented remission.

single_vs_recurrent.description: Confused a single episode with recurrent depression.

coded_mdd_without_documentation.description: Coded major depressive disorder when only 'depression' is documented.

bipolar_schizophrenia.title: Schizophrenia, schizoaffective and bipolar disorder
bipolar_schizophrenia.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's psychiatric condition.

values.bipolar_depressed_moderate: Bipolar disorder, current episode depressed, moderate
values.bipolar_partial_remission: Bipolar disorder in partial remission, last episode depressed
values.bipolar_full_remission: Bipolar disorder in full remission, last episode depressed

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the type or episode is documented.

bipolar_coded_as_depression.description: Coded major depression for the depressed episode of bipolar disorder.

remission_coded_active.description: Coded an active episode when the provider documents remission.

full_partial_confused.description: Confused full and partial remission (full remission has no HCC; partial does).

assumed_episode.description: Coded an episode or remission status the provider did not document.

personality_eating.title: Personality and eating disorders
personality_eating.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's personality or eating disorder.

values.anorexia_restricting_remission: Anorexia nervosa, restricting type, in remission

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the type, severity or remission is documented.

assumed_type.description: Coded a type the provider did not document.

remission_coded_active.description: Coded an active severity when the provider documents remission.

wrong_eating_type.description: Confused the type of anorexia (restricting vs binge-purge) or anorexia vs bulimia.

blood_cancers.title: Myeloma, myelodysplastic syndrome and lymphoma
blood_cancers.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood cancer or its history (only that code).

values.myeloma_active: Multiple myeloma, on treatment, not in remission
values.nhl_history: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma treated years ago, no disease

assumed_remission.description: Coded remission that is not documented.

missed_remission.description: Coded myeloma without remission when remission is documented.

active_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the cancer is still being treated.

history_coded_active.description: Coded an active cancer after treatment is complete with no evidence of disease.

symptom_for_disease.description: Coded the anemia instead of the documented myelodysplastic syndrome.

cancer_status.title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
cancer_status.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.

values.history: Treated in the past, no evidence of it now

history_coded_active.description: Coded a current cancer after treatment ended with no evidence of the primary.

active_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the cancer is still being treated.

missed_mets.description: Left out a documented metastasis (secondary malignancy).

wrong_met_site.description: Coded the metastasis to the wrong site.

unspecified_laterality.description: Used an unspecified-side code when the side is documented.

metabolic_endocrine.title: Gaucher, Fabry, amyloidosis, adrenal and pituitary disorders
metabolic_endocrine.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's metabolic or endocrine disorder (only that code).

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the specific disorder or type is documented.

assumed_type.description: Coded a specific type the provider did not document.

understated_adrenal.description: Coded unspecified adrenal insufficiency (no HCC) for documented Addison's disease (HCC 51).

overstated_adrenal.description: Coded Addison's disease when only adrenal insufficiency is documented.

drug_cushing_coded_disease.description: Coded pituitary Cushing's disease (HCC 51) for drug-induced Cushing's syndrome (no HCC).

stroke_inpatient.title: Stroke in the hospital: ischemic, hemorrhage or TIA
stroke_inpatient.question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the cerebrovascular event (only that code).

values.hemorrhage: Intracerebral hemorrhage, not due to injury

tia_coded_stroke.description: Coded a stroke for a transient ischemic attack (no infarction).

stroke_coded_tia.description: Coded a TIA when an infarction is documented.

wrong_stroke_type.description: Confused ischemic stroke and intracerebral hemorrhage.

acute_coded_history.description: Coded history of stroke during the hospital stay for the acute stroke.

stroke_sequelae.title: Stroke: history or residual deficits
stroke_sequelae.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's past stroke and any residual deficits.

coded_acute_stroke.description: Used an acute stroke code (I63.-) after the acute episode.

history_with_deficit.description: Coded personal history (Z86.73) when a residual deficit is documented.

sequela_without_deficit.description: Coded a stroke sequela when no residual deficit is documented.

wrong_dominance.description: Picked the wrong dominant or non-dominant side.

unspecified_side.description: Used an unspecified-side code when the side is documented.

paralysis.title: Quadriplegia, paraplegia, monoplegia and spinal cord disorders
paralysis.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's paralysis or spinal cord condition (only that code).

values.monoplegia_right_leg: Monoplegia of the right leg, dominance not stated

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified paralysis when the level or completeness is documented.

assumed_completeness.description: Coded complete or incomplete when the provider did not say.

wrong_dominance_default.description: Used the wrong side default: when dominance is not documented, the right side is dominant.

myelopathy_coded_separately.description: Coded unspecified spinal cord disease for myelopathy that has a combination code with spondylosis.

cp_ataxia_brain.title: Cerebral palsy, hereditary ataxia, Huntington's and anoxic brain damage
cp_ataxia_brain.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's neurological condition (only that code).

values.anoxic_brain: Anoxic brain damage after a past cardiac arrest

cp_type_confused.description: Coded the wrong type of cerebral palsy (quadriplegic is HCC 191; other types are HCC 192).

cp_coded_as_quadriplegia.description: Coded quadriplegia (G82.5-) instead of quadriplegic cerebral palsy (G80.0).

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the specific disorder is documented.

symptom_for_disease.description: Coded a symptom (chorea) instead of the documented disease.

history_for_current.description: Coded only the past event (cardiac arrest) and missed the lasting brain damage.

nerve_muscle.title: ALS, myasthenia gravis, CIDP and muscular dystrophy
nerve_muscle.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's neuromuscular condition (only that code).

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the specific disorder is documented.

missed_exacerbation.description: Coded myasthenia gravis without exacerbation when an acute exacerbation is documented.

assumed_exacerbation.description: Coded an exacerbation of myasthenia gravis that is not documented.

polyneuropathy_coded_cidp.description: Coded CIDP when the provider documents only polyneuropathy.

cardiomyopathy.title: Cardiomyopathy: hypertrophic, ischemic or unspecified
cardiomyopathy.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's cardiomyopathy (only that code).

ischemic_coded_as_i42.description: Coded a cardiomyopathy from category I42 for ischemic cardiomyopathy (I42 excludes it: I25.5).

missed_obstruction.description: Missed that the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is obstructive (or assumed obstruction).

assumed_type.description: Coded a specific type of cardiomyopathy the provider did not document.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified cardiomyopathy when the type is documented.

heart_failure.title: Heart failure: type, acuity and hypertension
heart_failure.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any related hypertension.

missed_htn_hf_link.description: Coded hypertension and heart failure separately instead of hypertensive heart disease (I11.0).

acuity_down.description: Coded chronic heart failure when an acute-on-chronic exacerbation is documented.

acuity_up.description: Coded an acute exacerbation that is not documented.

acute_only.description: Coded acute heart failure when it is acute on chronic.

unspecified_hf.description: Used unspecified heart failure (I50.9) when type and acuity are documented.

wrong_hf_type.description: Confused systolic and diastolic heart failure.

heart_failure_advanced.title: Heart failure: end-stage, assist device and acute
heart_failure_advanced.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any heart assist device.

values.end_stage: End-stage heart failure, type not stated
values.lvad: Chronic systolic heart failure with an LVAD

unspecified_hf.description: Used unspecified heart failure when end-stage heart failure is documented.

missed_code_also.description: Left out the type of heart failure that I50.84 says to code also.

understated_end_stage.description: Coded only the type of heart failure and missed that it is end-stage.

missed_device_status.description: Left out the presence of a heart assist device (LVAD).

acute_coded_chronic.description: Coded chronic or acute on chronic heart failure for a first, acute episode.

wrong_hf_type.description: Coded the wrong type of heart failure (systolic vs diastolic).

mi_angina.title: Myocardial infarction and angina
mi_angina.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's coronary disease, angina or myocardial infarction.

values.cad_unstable: Coronary artery disease with unstable angina
values.cad_angina: Coronary artery disease with angina, type not stated

acute_mi_coded_old.description: Coded old myocardial infarction (I25.2) within 4 weeks of the infarction.

old_mi_coded_acute.description: Coded an acute myocardial infarction (I21) more than 4 weeks after it, with no ongoing care.

missed_combination.description: Coded coronary disease and angina separately instead of the I25.11- combination code.

understated_angina.description: Coded unspecified angina when unstable angina is documented.

overstated_angina.description: Coded unstable angina when the type of angina is not documented.

atrial_fibrillation.title: Atrial fibrillation: type, history and anticoagulation
atrial_fibrillation.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's atrial fibrillation and related long-term drug therapy.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91) when the type is documented.

wrong_af_type.description: Coded a different type of atrial fibrillation than documented.

assumed_type.description: Coded a type of atrial fibrillation the provider did not document.

resolved_coded_current.description: Coded current atrial fibrillation after it was cured and is no longer treated.

current_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the atrial fibrillation is still current.

antiplatelet_vs_anticoagulant.description: Used the antiplatelet code (Z79.02) for an anticoagulant.

obesity_bmi.title: Obesity, morbid obesity and BMI
obesity_bmi.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's weight diagnosis and BMI, if reportable.

bmi_without_dx.description: Reported a BMI code without a provider-documented weight diagnosis.

obesity_from_bmi.description: Coded obesity from the BMI alone; the provider must diagnose it.

morbid_from_bmi.description: Upgraded the provider's 'obesity' to morbid obesity from the BMI.

missed_morbid.description: Coded obesity, unspecified when the provider documented morbid obesity.

missed_bmi.description: Left out the BMI code when it is reportable.

asthma_cf.title: Asthma severity and cystic fibrosis
asthma_cf.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's asthma or cystic fibrosis (only that code).

values.severe_persistent_exac: Severe persistent asthma with acute exacerbation

understated_severity.description: Coded a milder or unspecified asthma when severe persistent asthma is documented.

overstated_severity.description: Coded severe persistent asthma when moderate persistent is documented.

missed_exacerbation.description: Left out the documented acute exacerbation.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the manifestation is documented.

fibrosis_airway.title: Pulmonary fibrosis, scleroderma lung, tracheostomy and ventilator
fibrosis_airway.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's lung fibrosis or airway status.

understated_fibrosis.description: Coded unspecified pulmonary fibrosis when idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is documented.

assumed_idiopathic.description: Coded idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis when the cause is not documented.

missed_combination.description: Coded systemic sclerosis and lung fibrosis separately instead of the combination code M34.81.

missed_vent_status.description: Coded the tracheostomy but missed the ventilator dependence.

pneumonia_inpatient.title: Pneumonia, lung abscess, empyema and respiratory arrest in the hospital
pneumonia_inpatient.question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the main lung condition (only that code).

missed_specific_pneumonia.description: Coded pneumonia with unspecified organism when a specific type or organism is documented.

assumed_organism.description: Coded a specific pneumonia type or organism that is not documented.

wrong_lung_condition.description: Coded a different lung condition than the one documented.

arrest_coded_failure.description: Coded respiratory failure for a respiratory arrest.

pad_atherosclerosis.title: Peripheral artery disease: stage, side and ulcer
pad_atherosclerosis.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's peripheral artery disease and any related ulcer.

assumed_atherosclerosis.description: Coded atherosclerosis or a complication that is not documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified PVD (I73.9) when atherosclerosis with a complication is documented.

understated_severity.description: Coded a lower stage of atherosclerosis than documented.

overstated_severity.description: Coded a higher stage of atherosclerosis than documented.

missed_ulcer_code.description: Left out the ulcer code (L97.-) that the atherosclerosis-with-ulceration code asks for.

vte_status.title: DVT and PE: acute, chronic or history
vte_status.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism (only that code).

acute_coded_history.description: Coded history of a clot while the acute clot is still being treated.

history_coded_active.description: Coded an active clot after treatment was completed and it resolved.

acute_chronic_confused.description: Confused acute and chronic thrombosis or embolism.

chronic_coded_history.description: Coded history when chronic thrombosis or embolism is documented.

copd_respiratory.title: COPD, respiratory failure and home oxygen
copd_respiratory.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's chronic lung disease and any respiratory failure or oxygen dependence.

values.oxygen_only: Home oxygen, no respiratory failure documented
values.chronic_failure: Chronic respiratory failure with hypoxia, on home oxygen

missed_exacerbation.description: Coded stable COPD when an acute exacerbation is documented.

unsupported_exacerbation.description: Coded an exacerbation that is not documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used COPD, unspecified (J44.9) when emphysema is documented.

respiratory_failure_from_oxygen.description: Coded respiratory failure from home oxygen use alone; the provider must diagnose it.

missed_oxygen.description: Left out dependence on supplemental oxygen (Z99.81).

missed_respiratory_failure.description: Left out documented chronic respiratory failure (HCC 213).

unspecified_respiratory_failure.description: Used unspecified respiratory failure when hypoxia is documented.

acute_on_chronic_unsupported.description: Coded acute on chronic respiratory failure when only chronic failure is documented.

pressure_ulcer.title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
pressure_ulcer.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.

unspecified_when_documented.description: Used the unspecified-stage code when the stage (or unstageable) is documented.

understated_stage.description: Coded a lower stage than documented.

overstated_stage.description: Coded a higher stage than documented.

assumed_stage.description: Coded a stage the provider did not document.

healed_coded.description: Coded a pressure ulcer that is completely healed.

bone_lupus_skin.title: Osteomyelitis, lupus and blistering skin disease
bone_lupus_skin.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's condition (only that code).

values.discoid: Discoid lupus of the skin only

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the organ involvement or type is documented.

discoid_coded_sle.description: Coded systemic lupus (HCC 94) for discoid lupus limited to the skin (no HCC).

ulcer_burn.title: Non-pressure ulcer depth and burn extent
ulcer_burn.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the ulcer, or for the burn extent (T31) when the note is about a burn (only that code).

values.ulcer_fat: Chronic ulcer of right heel, fat layer exposed
values.ulcer_bone: Chronic ulcer of right heel down to bone
values.ulcer_depth_unknown: Chronic ulcer of right heel, depth not stated
values.burn_major: Burns over 30-39% of the body, 20-29% third degree
values.burn_minor: Burns over 10-19% of the body, under 10% third degree

understated_depth.description: Coded a shallower ulcer depth than documented (bone necrosis is HCC 380).

assumed_depth.description: Coded an ulcer depth the provider did not document.

wrong_burn_extent.description: Used the wrong T31 extent: the code depends on total body surface and the third-degree percentage.

liver_disease.title: Liver disease: cirrhosis, hepatitis C, fatty liver
liver_disease.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's liver disease.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified cirrhosis when alcoholic cirrhosis is documented.

assumed_cause.description: Coded a cause of cirrhosis the provider did not document.

missed_ascites.description: Left out documented ascites (alcoholic cirrhosis with ascites).

unsupported_ascites.description: Coded ascites that is not documented.

unspecified_hepatitis.description: Used unspecified viral hepatitis C instead of chronic hepatitis C.

current_coded_history.description: Coded personal history while the hepatitis C is still present.

history_coded_active.description: Coded current hepatitis C after it was cured.

coded_cirrhosis.description: Coded cirrhosis when only fatty liver is documented.

liver_failure_biliary.title: Liver failure, portal hypertension and bile duct disease
liver_failure_biliary.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's liver or bile duct condition.

understated_liver.description: Coded cirrhosis or unspecified liver disease when chronic liver failure is documented.

missed_portal_htn.description: Left out portal hypertension (HCC 63, which outranks cirrhosis).

wrong_cholangitis.description: Confused primary biliary and primary sclerosing cholangitis, or used other cholangitis.

assumed_stones.description: Coded a gallstone code for bile duct obstruction without stones.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the specific condition is documented.

status_codes.title: Amputation and ostomy status
status_codes.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM status codes this note supports.

missed_status.description: Left out a documented status that still applies.

attention_vs_status.description: Used an 'attention to' encounter code (Z43.-) instead of the status code (Z93.-).

wrong_ostomy.description: Confused a colostomy and an ileostomy.

reversed_coded.description: Coded an ostomy that was reversed.

neuro_conditions.title: Epilepsy, Parkinson's disease and multiple sclerosis
neuro_conditions.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's neurological condition.

values.single_seizure_history: One seizure years ago, none since

unsupported_intractable.description: Coded intractable epilepsy when it is not documented.

missed_intractable.description: Coded non-intractable epilepsy when intractable is documented.

symptom_for_diagnosis.description: Coded a seizure symptom (R56.9) instead of the documented diagnosis.

coded_resolved_seizure.description: Coded a current seizure condition for a single seizure years ago with no recurrence.

parkinsonism_vs_parkinsons.description: Used parkinsonism (G20.C) when Parkinson's disease is documented.

unsupported_fluctuations.description: Coded motor fluctuations that are not documented.

nonbillable_code.description: Reported G35, which needs more characters in FY2027.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used MS, unspecified when the type is documented.

assumed_type.description: Coded an MS type the provider did not document.

transplant_status.title: Transplant status and rejection
transplant_status.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.

missed_status.description: Left out a transplant status code that carries an HCC.

wrong_organ.description: Coded the status for the wrong organ or combination.

missed_second_organ.description: Coded only one organ of a combined transplant.

bone_marrow_vs_stem_cell.description: Confused bone marrow and stem cell transplant status.

status_for_complication.description: Coded transplant status when a transplant complication (rejection) is documented.

rheumatoid_arthritis.title: Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and methotrexate
rheumatoid_arthritis.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's arthritis and related long-term drug therapy.

coded_ra_for_oa.description: Coded rheumatoid arthritis when the provider documents osteoarthritis.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used rheumatoid arthritis, unspecified (M06.9) when rheumatoid factor and sites are documented.

assumed_rf_status.description: Coded rheumatoid factor status the provider did not document.

nonspecific_drug_code.description: Used 'other long-term drug therapy' (Z79.899) when a specific code exists.

opportunistic.title: Opportunistic infections
opportunistic.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's infection (only that code).

missed_specific_infection.description: Coded a general pneumonia or infection code instead of the opportunistic infection.

thrush_coded_esophagitis.description: Coded Candida esophagitis for oral thrush (thrush has no HCC).

esophagitis_coded_thrush.description: Coded oral thrush when Candida esophagitis is documented.

sepsis_inpatient.title: Sepsis, severe sepsis, septic shock, urosepsis and bacteremia
sepsis_inpatient.question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the sepsis, severe sepsis or septic shock only (not the local infection or the organ dysfunction). If none applies, choose 'no code'.

values.sepsis: Sepsis, organism not identified, no organ dysfunction
values.severe_sepsis: Severe sepsis with kidney injury, no shock

overstated_severe.description: Added severe sepsis or septic shock without a documented associated organ dysfunction or shock.

missed_severe.description: Left out severe sepsis (R65.20) when an organ dysfunction caused by the sepsis is documented.

missed_shock.description: Coded severe sepsis without shock when septic shock is documented.

unspecified_organism.description: Used sepsis, unspecified organism when the organism is documented.

urosepsis_coded_sepsis.description: Coded sepsis for 'urosepsis' (a nonspecific term with no code: query the provider).

bacteremia_coded_sepsis.description: Coded sepsis for bacteremia that the provider says is not sepsis.

hiv_status.title: HIV: Z21, B20 or R75
hiv_status.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's HIV status (only that code).

values.asymptomatic: HIV positive, never ill from it

overstated_hiv.description: Coded HIV disease (B20) for asymptomatic HIV infection.

understated_hiv.description: Coded asymptomatic HIV (Z21) when AIDS or a prior HIV-related illness is documented.

coded_unconfirmed_hiv.description: Coded HIV infection from an inconclusive test.

bowel_obstruction.title: Bowel obstruction and ileus in the hospital
bowel_obstruction.question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the bowel obstruction or ileus (only that code).

missed_cause.description: Used unspecified obstruction when adhesions are documented as the cause.

assumed_cause.description: Coded adhesions as the cause when no cause is documented.

gi_conditions.title: Crohn's, ulcerative colitis, IBS and pancreatitis
gi_conditions.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's digestive condition.

values.crohns_small: Crohn's disease of the small intestine

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified-site code when the site or extent is documented.

assumed_site.description: Coded a site or extent the provider did not document.

ibs_coded_as_ibd.description: Coded inflammatory bowel disease when the provider documents irritable bowel syndrome.

history_coded_chronic.description: Coded chronic pancreatitis for a past acute attack that resolved.

chronic_coded_acute.description: Coded acute pancreatitis or history when chronic pancreatitis is documented.

blood_disorders.title: Sickle cell variants, hemolytic and aplastic anemia, hemophilia, neutropenia
blood_disorders.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood disorder (only that code).

values.hb_sc: Sickle cell-hemoglobin C disease, no crisis

wrong_sickle_type.description: Coded Hb-SS sickle cell disease or trait instead of the documented sickle cell variant.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the specific disorder is documented.

drug_cause_missed.description: Coded other pancytopenia (HCC 109) for pancytopenia caused by chemotherapy (no HCC).

assumed_drug_cause.description: Coded chemotherapy-induced pancytopenia when no drug cause is documented.

hemophilia_coded_other_factor.description: Coded another clotting factor deficiency instead of hemophilia A or B.

neutropenia_unspecified.description: Used unspecified neutropenia when cyclic neutropenia is documented.

blood_immune.title: Sickle cell, ITP and immunodeficiency
blood_immune.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's blood or immune disorder.

trait_coded_as_disease.description: Coded sickle cell disease for sickle cell trait.

disease_coded_as_trait.description: Coded sickle cell trait when sickle cell disease is documented.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used unspecified thrombocytopenia when ITP is documented.

assumed_cause.description: Coded ITP when the provider documents thrombocytopenia without a cause.

nonspecific_immunodeficiency.description: Used unspecified immunodeficiency when CVID is documented.

eye_conditions.title: Macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy
eye_conditions.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's eye condition.

values.wet_amd_scar: Wet AMD, right eye, inactive scar
values.npdr_mild: Mild nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy, right eye

wet_dry_confused.description: Confused wet (exudative) and dry (nonexudative) macular degeneration.

wrong_cnv_status.description: Coded the wrong stage of wet macular degeneration (active, inactive or scar).

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when the type and eye are documented.

understated_retinopathy.description: Coded nonproliferative or unspecified retinopathy when proliferative is documented.

overstated_retinopathy.description: Coded proliferative retinopathy when mild nonproliferative is documented.

hip_fracture.title: Hip fracture: initial, subsequent or history
hip_fracture.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's hip fracture at this visit.

initial_for_subsequent.description: Used the initial-encounter 7th character (A) at a follow-up visit while the fracture heals.

subsequent_for_initial.description: Used the subsequent-encounter 7th character (D) for a newly diagnosed fracture under active treatment.

healing_coded_as_history.description: Coded history of fracture while the fracture is still healing.

healed_coded_as_fracture.description: Coded a fracture that has completely healed.

alcohol_use.title: Alcohol use disorder: severity and remission
alcohol_use.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's alcohol use, if any is reportable.

coded_social_drinking.description: Coded alcohol use when the provider documents only social drinking.

severity_up.description: Coded dependence (F10.2-) for a mild use disorder.

severity_down.description: Coded abuse (F10.1-) for a moderate or severe use disorder.

missed_remission.description: Coded the disorder as active when it is in remission.

unspecified_use.description: Used 'alcohol use, unspecified' when a use disorder is documented.

drug_use.title: Drug use disorders and substance-induced psychosis
drug_use.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's substance use disorder.

values.opioid_remission: Opioid use disorder, severe, in early remission
values.cocaine_psychotic: Severe cocaine use disorder with cocaine-induced psychotic disorder, hallucinations
values.alcohol_psychotic: Severe alcohol use disorder with alcohol-induced psychotic disorder, hallucinations

mild_coded_dependence.description: Coded dependence for a mild use disorder (mild = abuse in ICD-10-CM).

moderate_coded_abuse.description: Coded abuse for a moderate or severe use disorder (= dependence).

missed_remission.description: Left out the remission the provider documents.

cannabis_hcc_assumed.description: Coded cannabis dependence for mild cannabis use disorder (cannabis abuse has no HCC).

missed_psychotic.description: Coded the use disorder alone and missed the substance-induced psychotic disorder.

head_injury.title: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in the hospital
head_injury.question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the head injury (only that code).

values.tbi_loc_long: Diffuse brain injury, unconscious over 24 hours, recovered
values.tbi_loc_short: Diffuse brain injury, unconscious 30 minutes or less

wrong_loc_duration.description: Used the wrong loss-of-consciousness duration (it decides HCC 397, 398 or 399).

unspecified_loc.description: Used unspecified loss of consciousness when the duration is documented.

concussion_coded_tbi.description: Coded a diffuse brain injury (HCC 398) for a concussion (no HCC).

spine_amputation.title: Vertebral fracture and amputation
spine_amputation.question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's vertebral fracture or amputation (only that code).

values.vert_initial: Traumatic L1 fracture, new, active treatment
values.vert_followup: Traumatic L1 fracture, routine follow-up while healing
values.vert_osteoporotic: Osteoporosis with new vertebral fracture from a minor fall
values.amputation_acute: Traumatic amputation of right lower leg, new

initial_for_subsequent.description: Used the initial-encounter 7th character (A) at a routine follow-up while the fracture heals.

subsequent_for_initial.description: Used the subsequent-encounter 7th character (D) for a new fracture under active treatment.

osteoporotic_coded_traumatic.description: Coded a traumatic fracture for a fracture from a minor fall in known osteoporosis (use M80).

missed_fracture.description: Coded osteoporosis without the current fracture.

acute_status_confused.description: Confused a new traumatic amputation with amputation status from the past.

meat_support.title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
meat_support.question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Choose 'no code' if none is supported.

values.med_list_only: A medication on the list only

missed_supported_condition.description: Did not code a chronic condition the provider monitored, evaluated, assessed or treated.

coded_without_meat.description: Coded a condition that only appears in a problem list or history without being addressed.

coded_from_med_list.description: Inferred and coded a diagnosis from a medication list.

unspecified_when_specified.description: Used an unspecified code when severity/type was documented.

acceptable_sources.title: Acceptable sources for risk adjustment
acceptable_sources.question: Can this document support a diagnosis code for risk adjustment? Assign the code it supports, or 'no code' if it cannot be used.

values.office_visit: Signed office visit with a physician, NP or PA

coded_radiology_report.description: Coded from a diagnostic radiology report, which is not an acceptable risk-adjustment source.

coded_non_acceptable_provider.description: Coded from a visit with a provider type that is not acceptable (e.g. a nurse visit).

coded_unsigned_note.description: Coded from a note without a provider signature and credentials.

rejected_acceptable_source.description: Assigned no code although a signed face-to-face visit with an acceptable provider supports it.
